cards.name: Factures observées
cards.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS factures_observees
FROM v_bi_factures v WHERE 1=1
[[AND v.date_facture >= {{date_debut}}]] [[AND v.date_facture <= {{date_fin}}]]

cards.name: Montant des factures alertées rejetées (MGA)
cards.sql:
SELECT SUM(v.montant_total) AS montant_facture_rejetee_mga
FROM v_bi_factures v
WHERE v.is_alert AND v.decision = 'rejete' AND v.devise = 'MGA'
[[AND v.date_facture >= {{date_debut}}]] [[AND v.date_facture <= {{date_fin}}]]

cards.name: Rappel sur les fraudes valides labellisées (%)
cards.sql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE v.is_alert)
       / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS rappel_pct
FROM v_bi_factures v
      WHERE v.est_fraude AND v.est_valide AND v.is_alert IS NOT NULL
[[AND v.date_facture >= {{date_debut}}]] [[AND v.date_facture <= {{date_fin}}]]

cards.name: Taux de rejet des alertes décidées (%)
cards.sql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE v.decision = 'rejete')
       / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS taux_rejet_pct
FROM v_bi_factures v
WHERE v.is_alert AND v.decision IN ('valide', 'rejete')
[[AND v.date_facture >= {{date_debut}}]] [[AND v.date_facture <= {{date_fin}}]]

cards.name: Factures avec prédiction (%)
cards.sql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE v.is_alert IS NOT NULL)
       / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 3) AS couverture_scoring_pct
FROM v_bi_factures v WHERE 1=1
[[AND v.date_facture >= {{date_debut}}]] [[AND v.date_facture <= {{date_fin}}]]

cards.name: Volume de factures par mois
cards.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', v.date_facture) AS mois,
       COUNT(*) AS nb_factures
FROM v_bi_factures v WHERE 1=1
[[AND v.date_facture >= {{date_debut}}]] [[AND v.date_facture <= {{date_fin}}]]
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cards.name: Montants facturés vs alertés par mois (MGA)
cards.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', v.date_facture) AS mois,
       SUM(v.montant_total) AS montant_facture_mga,
       SUM(v.montant_total) FILTER (WHERE v.is_alert) AS montant_alerte_mga
FROM v_bi_factures v
WHERE v.devise = 'MGA'
[[AND v.date_facture >= {{date_debut}}]] [[AND v.date_facture <= {{date_fin}}]]
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cards.name: Top 10 prestataires alertés (factures)
cards.sql:
SELECT v.prestataire_nom, COUNT(*) AS nb_factures_alertees
FROM v_bi_factures v
WHERE v.is_alert
[[AND v.date_facture >= {{date_debut}}]] [[AND v.date_facture <= {{date_fin}}]]
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
